answer.short: Splitting the diagram into squares the size of the smallest square gives 32 shaded squares out of 64, so $\frac{32}{64}=\frac{1}{2}$.
answer.worked:
Divide each region into squares the size of the smallest square. There are 64 equal squares altogether, of which 32 are shaded.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Shaded fraction}&=\frac{32}{64}\\&=\frac{32\div32}{64\div32}\\&=\frac{1}{2}\end{align*}$$
